list.snippet: Installed cost: Expect roughly $3.75 to $5.00 per square foot installed—about 15% to 25% more than standard architectural shingles—depending on roof pitch, tear-off needs, and local labor in areas like Heber City or along the Wasatch Front.

Insurance discounts: Some insurers offer policy discounts for verified UL 2218 Class 4 roofs, though eligibility and savings vary by carrier, policy, and documentation. Check with your insurer before relying on a discount to offset the upgrade.

Beyond hail: Class 4 measures impact resistance, not wind or fire ratings. Confirm wind ratings and proper installation (flashing, ventilation, and underlayment) for mountain and canyon winds and snow loads.
